biggest_catch: The rewards depend on how and when you charge — Con Edison cites an average of $400/year, not a guarantee. You need a compatible EV or charger and you must charge inside Con Edison's NYC/Westchester service area on the standard rate.
catches: The $400/year figure is an average — your rewards depend on your charging habits (off-peak charging earns $0.10/kWh).
You must be a Con Edison residential customer in New York City or Westchester on the standard electricity rate.
Requires a compatible electric vehicle or networked charger enrolled in the program.
The $35/month summer peak-avoidance reward requires avoiding charging during peak events in summer months.
The $25 referral reward only pays when your referred friend enrolls and participates.

steps: Confirm you're a Con Edison residential customer in NYC or Westchester on the standard electricity rate with a compatible EV or networked charger.
Enroll in SmartCharge New York on the Con Edison page and connect your vehicle or charger to the program.
Charge during off-peak hours to earn $0.10/kWh — this is where most of the rewards come from.
Collect the $25 reward after your first three months of participation.
In summer, avoid charging during peak events to earn up to $35/month plus the $35 summer bonus.
Refer friends who also enroll and participate to earn $25 per referral.
